mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 4.5% is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced discount rates and increased equity valuations.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS < 4.5% (t-test p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE > 5.0 (t-test p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in housing starts (HOUST below 1200) and retail sales (RSAFS below 385000) signals consumer demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when HOUST < 1200 and RSAFS < 385000 (t-test p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), reduced liquidity and higher risk aversion lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% (t-test p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A low industrial production level (INDPRO below 115) signals a weakening economy, reducing corporate earnings growth and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 115 (t-test p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level below 1200 signals weak consumer demand, reducing economic activity and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when HOUST < 1200 (t-test p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in employment (PAYEMS below 138500) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE above 5.0%) signals labor market deterioration, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when PAYEMS < 138500 and UNRATE > 5.0 (t-test p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a consumer demand contraction regime (RSAFS below 385000), reduced consumer spending lowers corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when RSAFS < 385000 (t-test p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.
